title: Design Babulus's Kanbus types and workflows
description: Write config/babulus.kanbus.yml for the marketing objects. Use the parked designs from closed epic babulus-b2f481 as input: Campaign, Brief, Deliverable (kind: LandingPage | Video | ImageSet | SocialCopy | PpcCopy; render status lives here), Creative, Idea, Post, Slot, AdDraft, and its boundary rules (nothing auto-posts or enables spend; a human approves before queueing). Custom fields go in issue.custom (Prospectus pattern, see config/prospectus.kanbus.yml and src/prospect.ts). Decide how to model the Campaign -> Brief -> Deliverable -> Creative tree given the Kanbus API limit below.
